findings.message: The base-branch parser still exists twice, in lib/base-ref.sh (awk + sed) and in hooks/branch.ts (regex). The fix aligned quote stripping and column-0 comments, but the two block-end rules still differ. The awk ends the git: block only at a column-0 line starting with a letter or underscore. The branch.ts regex ends it at any column-0 line that is not a comment, such as `---`, a quoted key or a list dash. Quoted values also differ: the awk keeps inner spaces, while branch.ts stops at the first space or quote. Make the block-end rule and the value rule identical in both, or have one side call the other. Add parity rows to the tests.
findings.scenario:
config.yaml `git:
  strategy: x
---
  base_branch: develop` -> base-ref.sh (size cap) reads `develop`, while branch.ts ends the block at `---` and falls back to origin/HEAD or main. `base_branch: "my branch"` -> the awk yields `my branch`, branch.ts yields `my`.
